messages:
Maya: Quick design question for the Private setup preflight UI — instead of a big log dump, can we show a compact "preflight strip" that surface top-priority prereqs (highest impact first) with a short recommended fix, and tuck full logs behind an expand? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE

Riley: +1 to prioritizing by impact. My only ask is make the primary action explicit ("Retry vs. Open details"). Users shouldn't have to guess where to click to resolve.

Sam: Implementation detail: current agent returns a single combined log. We'll need the API to return structured checks: check_id, severity (critical/major/minor), short_title, quick_fix, raw_log_url, kb_slug. Also an overall status enum. I can write the contract if we agree fields.

ops-bot: Preflight run: 2026-04-12T11:05:02Z  results: 28 checks total, 2 critical failures, 5 warnings, 21 ok. Raw logs: https://internal/preflight/2183001234/log.txt. Available fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Copy draft for the strip header: "Preflight finished — 28 checks: 2 failures, 5 warnings, 21 OK." For critical item microcopy: "Cannot reach image registry  Quick fix: allow outbound HTTPS (443) from host to the registry." Keep it plain English, no infra shortcuts.

Jamal: Accessibility things: chips must include textual labels (Fail/Warn/OK) in addition to color. Use role="status" for the summary and announce when preflight finishes with aria-live="polite". For expanded logs, ensure the expand button has aria-controls and an accessible name. Don't hide content with display:none for screen readers.

Maya: UX Q: should the copy diagnostic button be on the strip or only in expanded view? My vote: small copy icon on the strip (copies summary), and full "Export diagnostics" in expanded panel (copies raw logs + metadata). Keeps common case quick.

Riley: Agree. Also propose a tiny "Why this matters" inline sentence under critical items only so we don't clutter the strip. Link to KB for others.

Sam: Feature-flagging idea: collapse-full-logs-by-default flag so we can measure click-through to details. Frontend can set collapsed=true based on flag. Backend doesn't need to change for flagging.

Keisha: I'll assemble KB slug mapping for the top 12 error codes this month and write both compact + explanatory microcopy variants for each. Will avoid terms like "egress" in primary copy per product guidance.

Jamal: Keyboard nav: ensure focus order goes Summary -> Priority item -> Expand -> Log panel -> Back to Summary. If log panel opens, move focus to its heading. Provide a skip link to jump back. Also ensure toast after copy has role="status" so SRs hear it.

Maya: Visual design: status chips should have a clear left icon (check/warn/x) + label. On mobile, chips wrap; primary action (expand) should be the first interactive element.

Riley: Also run contrast check on the status text and icon to meet AA. Critical red + white text is fine but confirm against dark mode.

Sam: I'll draft the API contract today: fields = check_id, severity, title, quick_fix, details_url, kb_slug, raw_log_url, overall_status. Target PR by end of week.

Maya: I'll update Figma with the strip, inline "why this matters" for criticals, the copy icon placement, and keyboard flow notes. Tagging @Keisha and @Jamal for copy and accessibility review.

Keisha: Will review copy tomorrow and push a short document with KB mappings and microcopy variants.

Jamal: Quick a11y nit: when preflight is running, use aria-busy on the summary container and update the live region with incremental progress (e.g., "Checking network... 12/28"). This helps users relying on SRs know status.

Maya: Good call. Let's do a 15m sync Thu 09:30 to finalize fields and copy. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
